caseName: Laschkewitsch v. Lincoln Life & Annuity Distribs., Inc.
caseNameFull: John B. LASCHKEWITSCH, as Administrator for the Estate of Ben Laschkewitsch v. LINCOLN LIFE AND ANNUITY DISTRIBUTORS, INC., dba Lincoln Financial Group.

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied, and petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit dismissed. See Rule 39.8.
